CustomField.description: This field contains the milestone date in a text format for reservation form
CustomField.formula: IF(MilestoneNumber__c == 1, 'Payable on the Reservation Date', 'Payable on or before' &" "& TEXT( DAY(MilestoneDate__c) ) &" "& CASE( TEXT( MONTH(MilestoneDate__c) ), '1','January', '2','February', '3','March', '4','April', '5','May', '6','June', '7','July', '8','August', '9','September', '10','October', '11','November', '12','December','') &" "& TEXT( YEAR(MilestoneDate__c)))
CustomField.label: Milestone Due Date Text
